title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #15

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should you do when relatives have a quarrel? (1 mark)
   A. Gossip
   B. Spread stories
   C. Forgive and make peace
   D. Take sides in anger

2. What should a traveller do if unable to know the Qibla exactly? (1 mark)
   A. Ask no one
   B. Wait a year
   C. Never pray
   D. Try their best and Allah accepts it

3. What is a good manner of making dua? (1 mark)
   A. Begin with praise and end with Amin
   B. Shout
   C. Ask only for toys
   D. Never ask

4. What does "'Alaq" refer to in Surah Al-Alaq? (1 mark)
   A. A mountain
   B. A clinging clot
   C. A pen
   D. A cave

5. Who narrated the eating hadith from the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Lahab
   B. Al-Hakim
   C. Ibn Majah
   D. Al-Bukhari

6. How many parts of the body touch the ground in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Seven
   C. Two
   D. Three

7. What are angels created from? (1 mark)
   A. Clay
   B. Light
   C. Fire
   D. Water

8. Which of these is a manner of dua? (1 mark)
   A. Ask with humility and hope
   B. Shout
   C. Give up quickly
   D. Demand

9. What does the Prophet say about wudhu on the Day of Judgement? (1 mark)
   A. Wudhu will be forgotten
   B. Nothing
   C. Believers will have shining marks from wudhu
   D. Only rich people will shine

10. How should we give sadaqah? (1 mark)
   A. Loudly to embarrass
   B. With shame
   C. With insults
   D. Quietly and kindly

11. What is a good weekly fitness plan for a child? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting all day
   B. No sleep
   C. Only sweets
   D. About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda

12. Which of these shows tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Blaming luck
   B. Doing nothing and hoping
   C. Taking an umbrella and trusting Allah
   D. Ignoring safety

13. What does spending on family for Allah's pleasure count as? (1 mark)
   A. Waste
   B. Charity
   C. Nothing
   D. A sin

14. What was the Prophet's answer? (1 mark)
   A. He said nothing
   B. He asked for destruction
   C. He hoped their descendants would worship Allah alone
   D. He said yes

15. How should we treat dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Kindly, but avoid their saliva
   B. Hit them
   C. Cruelly
   D. Ignore hunger

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what the Prophet taught about cutting and selling firewood. (3 marks)

17. State three benefits of saying the duas for leaving and entering the house. (3 marks)

18. How should a Muslim treat a person who asks for help? (4 marks)

19. Explain how the Prophet (S.A.W.) showed love to children. (3 marks)

20. What does twahara mean and why is it important? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Forgive and make peace
   Islam teaches forgiveness.

2. D — Try their best and Allah accepts it
   Allah does not burden beyond ability.

3. A — Begin with praise and end with Amin
   Dua begins with praise.

4. B — A clinging clot
   Man was created from a clinging clot.

5. D — Al-Bukhari
   The syllabus gives Al-Bukhari.

6. B — Seven
   Forehead, two palms, two knees, toes of both feet.

7. B — Light
   The Prophet said angels were created from light.

8. A — Ask with humility and hope
   Dua is humble.

9. C — Believers will have shining marks from wudhu
   Recorded by Muslim.

10. D — Quietly and kindly
   Protect dignity.

11. D — About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda
   Regular activity keeps fit.

12. C — Taking an umbrella and trusting Allah
   Do your part and trust Allah.

13. B — Charity
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

14. C — He hoped their descendants would worship Allah alone
   He chose mercy.

15. A — Kindly, but avoid their saliva
   Islam teaches kindness to animals.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Honest work, even hard work like cutting and selling firewood, is better than asking people who may give or refuse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest work, 1 mark for firewood, 1 mark for better than begging.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, remembering Allah, blessings and peace, following the Sunnah, building good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: With kindness and respect, without driving him away, help if in real need, give quietly, or make a kind reply and dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: He kissed and hugged them, including his grandson Al-Hasan, and said that those who show no mercy will not be shown mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Twahara means purity. It is a condition for prayer and other acts of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for importance.
